description: Search Gigstereo's marketplace of event providers in Colombia (DJs, mariachis, photographers, videographers, bands, decorators, catering…) by city and, optionally, service or name. Owner-verified profiles show a price range and reviews; unclaimed directory listings show neither. Link the user to each profileUrl. Content is in Spanish; prices are in Colombian pesos (COP).

category.description: Service wanted, in Spanish or English (e.g. mariachi, DJ, fotógrafo de bodas, wedding photographer) or a category slug from list_categories.

city.description: City in Colombia, e.g. Medellín, Bogotá, Cali, Barranquilla.

query.description: Optional free text matched against provider names and descriptions.

name: search_providers
title: Search event providers
